item.title: Google Killed My Apps. You Could Be Next
item.description: I’d like to share my personal experience dealing with unexpected suspensions and terminations of my Google Play Developer accounts. It’s been an ongoing journey involving appeals, email exchanges, and ultimately an EU Out-of-Court dispute request. My hope is that this story will help other developers who may find themselves in a similar situation. Background: Two Developer Accounts I originally maintained two separate Google Play Developer accounts, let’s call them Account A and Account B.
